placement.openmp_binding: each worker calls sched_setaffinity to one selected physical CPU; OMP_PROC_BIND=false
placement.memory_placement: per-thread aligned allocation first-touched by its pinned worker
placement.working_set_order: rotated by trial index across L1, L2, L3, DRAM

read_bandwidth.units: GB/s of useful sequential read bytes (decimal GB = 1e9 bytes)

auxiliary_one_per_l3.purpose: context only; not extrapolated to a 128-core node measurement

fp64_fma.reason: The supplied all-core process timed out only after the four successful read rows, during its optional adaptive FMA phase. The corrected calibration separates that optional phase and does not invoke it.

compute_ceiling.formula: 128 cores * 2.00 GHz base * 16 FP64 FLOP/cycle for two 256-bit AVX2 FMA operations
compute_ceiling.limitation: This is a datasheet/base-frequency roof, not an empirical sustained FMA result.

method.kernel: eight independent AVX2 load/add accumulators over aligned double arrays; read loop is noinline/noclone and memory-clobbered
method.allocation: posix_memalign(2 MiB); first-touch initialization inside pinned OpenMP workers; MADV_HUGEPAGE requested for working sets >=2 MiB
method.validation: exact all-ones checksum per run; independent SHA-256 validation of every raw file after retrieval
method.byte_interpretation: useful_read_GBps = bytes_per_thread * passes * threads / timed_seconds / 1e9; it is not memory-controller or interface-counter traffic
limitations: Cache-resident labels describe the selected working-set sizes and are not a proof of exclusive residency under every hardware policy.
The DRAM number is a standalone streaming-read reference, not an OpenFOAM solver-stage byte count.
No solver FLOP/byte intensity or optimization-arrow magnitude is inferred from this calibration.
No measured compute ceiling is reported; the FP64 value is nominal only.
